prompt:
A design-sprint storyboard drawn in Copic markers and black fineliner on white marker paper: three panels in a row, each with a short hand-lettered caption underneath. Panel 1: At home, a traveller looks at an unfinished China trip checklist. Screen text: "What have I missed?" Caption: Small tasks make departure feel uncertain. Panel 2: On a phone, the traveller completes short checks about their route, bookings and daily needs. Screen text: "Three tasks left" Caption: The checklist shows what needs attention. Panel 3: At the airport, the traveller sees a completed plan on their phone. Screen text: "Ready for China" Caption: They leave with fewer unanswered questions.
Style: mostly white paper showing through, with light cool grey marker shading only where needed to separate planes — keep it airy. One warm orange accent on the key screen elements. Loose confident linework, a few visible marker streaks but not filled in. People are simple sketched figures with no facial detail. Any text on a screen, card or sign is short, legible and spelled exactly as given; captions are hand-lettered in neat block capitals. Feels like a real concept storyboard stuck on a workshop wall. No logos, no brand names, no watermark. The three panels and their captions fill the frame edge to edge, with only a slim paper margin.
